components.name: Button
components.description: Triggers an action in the current view.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Shows a line pictogram from the Alora icon set.

components.name: Label
components.description: Names a form control.

components.name: Text
components.description: Shows reading text and metadata with a type role and a semantic tone.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Titles a view, section or card while respecting the document hierarchy.

components.name: Input
components.description: Collects one line of text.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Collects multiple lines of text.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Lets the user check one or more independent options.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Lets the user pick one option within a group.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Represents a person with their initials.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Non-interactive label that shows a status or a plan.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Informational pill with an optional icon.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indicates a wait of unknown duration.

components.name: Divider
components.description: Separates groups of content.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Briefly describes a control on hover or focus.

components.name: Logo
components.description: Shows the Alora brand mark, with or without the ALORA wordmark.

components.name: Link
components.description: Text action that navigates or triggers a light, secondary action.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Square button that shows only an icon.

components.name: IconTile
components.description: Tinted square or circle that frames an icon or a letter.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Shows measurable progress or how much of a limit is used.

components.name: Illustration
components.description: Draws one of the Alora illustrations with theme colors.

components.name: FormField
components.description: Groups a field's Label, Input, helper text and error message.

components.name: SearchField
components.description: Search field with an icon and a clear button.

components.name: ListItem
components.description: List row with three formats: person, definition or navigation.

components.name: TagChip
components.description: Selectable or removable chip.

components.name: Stat
components.description: Shows a metric with its label and an optional trend.

components.name: Notification
components.description: Communicates a system message with a tone, an action and a dismiss button.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Shows where the user is within a hierarchy.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Moves between pages of a long list.

components.name: NavigationItem
components.description: Main navigation entry with an icon and a label.

components.name: OptionCard
components.description: Large selectable card for one choice among a few, with a title and an optional description.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: Row of mutually exclusive options shown side by side.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Shows where the user is in a multi-step flow.

components.name: Dropzone
components.description: Area to pick or drop files for upload.

components.name: ClipItem
components.description: Row for one video clip: thumbnail, title, facts and a light action.

components.name: SummaryRow
components.description: Labelled fact with a leading icon, used to summarize what happened.

components.name: StatGroup
components.description: Two to four small metrics side by side inside one card.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.description: Title of a simple page or of a section inside it, with an optional icon, subtitle and action.

components.name: PeriodStepper
components.description: Moves backward and forward between periods (weeks, pay periods).

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Fixed main navigation on desktop.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Header of each view with a title, subtitle and actions.

components.name: SubmissionCard
components.description: Summarizes a clip submitted for review and its main action.

components.name: DataList
components.description: Read-only data section with a title and definition rows.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Explains why an area is empty and offers the next action.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Dialog for a decision or short task that interrupts the flow.

components.name: FormSection
components.description: Complete form with fields and actions.

components.name: TopBar
components.description: Header of a detail or task screen with a back button and a title.

components.name: ResultState
components.description: Full-screen outcome of a task: success with a summary, or failure with a way to retry.

components.name: ReviewCard
components.description: Delivered review in History, collapsed to a summary and expanded to show the coach note.

components.name: VideoPlayer
components.description: Plays a surf clip with Alora controls.

components.name: AvailabilityGrid
components.description: Weekly grid where a coach marks the hours they are available.

components.name: DashboardTemplate
components.description: Authenticated view: Sidebar + a content column (810px narrow, or full width with width=wide) with header and content slots.

components.name: AuthTemplate
components.description: Authentication and onboarding: centered canvas with a 400px form slot, optional Logo and illustrated background.

components.name: CoachQueuePage
components.description: Coach queue with real content: PageHeader, Stat row, search and filters, SubmissionCard ×3 and an EmptyState for no results.

components.name: SurferLoginPage
components.description: Surfer log in: AuthTemplate + FormSection.

planned.name: NavigationBar
planned.description: Bottom navigation on mobile; replaces Sidebar below 1024px.

planned.name: DataTable
planned.description: Table of comparable data with sorting and pagination.

planned.name: CommandPalette
planned.description: Global search for actions and surfers (⌘K).

planned.name: Select
planned.description: Single selection among more than 5 options.

tokens.name: typography.family.display
tokens.description: Family for headings, buttons, labels and numbers. Used in both source files.

tokens.name: typography.family.body
tokens.description: Family for reading text. Replaces Apple SD Gothic Neo (a macOS system font, not portable) and keeps it as a fallback.

tokens.name: shadow.elevation-low-light
tokens.description: Card elevation in the light theme.

tokens.name: breakpoint.2xl
tokens.description: Design width of the Coach and Surfer files.

tokens.name: color.background.surface-raised
tokens.description: Cards, stats, lists and fields on the canvas.

tokens.name: color.background.surface-sunken
tokens.description: Sunken areas inside a card (surfer quote, notes block).

tokens.name: color.background.brand-subtle
tokens.description: Background of selected or brand-highlighted elements.

tokens.name: color.background.highlight-subtle
tokens.description: Background of plan badges and warm highlights.

tokens.name: color.text.secondary
tokens.description: Supporting text: subtitles, metadata, stat labels.

tokens.name: color.text.tertiary
tokens.description: Low-priority text: placeholders, dates, metadata. Minimum contrast 4.5:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: color.text.on-action
tokens.description: Text on primary or destructive actions.

tokens.name: color.border.subtle
tokens.description: Default border for cards, fields and dividers.

tokens.name: color.border.default
tokens.description: Stronger border: unchecked checkbox and radio.

tokens.name: color.border.strong
tokens.description: High-contrast border: secondary button on hover.

tokens.name: color.border.brand
tokens.description: Border of active or selected elements.

tokens.name: color.border.danger
tokens.description: Border of fields with an error.

tokens.name: color.action.primary.background
tokens.description: Solid brand fill for selected controls and avatars (checkbox, switch, avatar). Darker than the CTA gradient so white content meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color.action.primary.background-start
tokens.description: Start of the primary button gradient, taken from the Coach Platform CTA (#3b8eaa → #5aaec8). White text on this gradient is 3.7–2.5:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1; kept on purpose to match the product design.

tokens.name: color.action.primary.background-end
tokens.description: End of the primary button gradient (#5aaec8).

tokens.name: color.action.primary.foreground
tokens.description: Text and icon on the main action.

tokens.name: color.action.ghost.background-hover
tokens.description: Hover background of actions without a container.

tokens.name: color.action.danger.background
tokens.description: Destructive action (cancel plan). Dark tone so white text meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color.action.danger.foreground
tokens.description: Destructive action text without a container (Sign out).

tokens.name: color.action.highlight.on-solid
tokens.description: Text on the solid warm option.

tokens.name: color.status.in-review.foreground
tokens.description: Submission being reviewed by the coach.

tokens.name: color.disabled.foreground
tokens.description: Text and icon of disabled controls.

tokens.name: color.media.background
tokens.description: Behind video and photos, in both themes.

tokens.name: color.media.foreground
tokens.description: Controls and text over video, in both themes.

tokens.name: color.media.track
tokens.description: Unplayed part of the video timeline.

tokens.name: size.space.3xs
tokens.description: Minimum gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: size.space.2xs
tokens.description: Inner spacing of badges and chips.

tokens.name: size.space.xs
tokens.description: Gap between icon and text in small controls.

tokens.name: size.space.small
tokens.description: Gap between icon and text; between closely related elements.

tokens.name: size.space.medium
tokens.description: Inner padding of compact cards and fields.

tokens.name: size.space.large
tokens.description: Card padding; gap between list items.

tokens.name: size.space.xl
tokens.description: Gap between sections within a view.

tokens.name: size.space.page-gutter
tokens.description: Side margin of the content on desktop (1440px).

tokens.name: size.layout.content-width
tokens.description: Maximum width of the content column.

tokens.name: size.layout.control-height
tokens.description: Default height of buttons and fields (44px touch target).

tokens.name: size.layout.target-minimum
tokens.description: Smallest hit area for any pointer target, including icon-only buttons inside other components (WCAG 2.2 target size, 24px).

tokens.name: size.layout.stat-min-width
tokens.description: Minimum width of a Stat before it wraps to a new row.

tokens.name: size.layout.icon-tile-medium
tokens.description: Icon tile next to a section title.

tokens.name: size.layout.icon-tile-large
tokens.description: Icon tile above a form or dialog.

tokens.name: size.layout.progress-height
tokens.description: Height of progress bars and the stepper track.

tokens.name: size.icon.extra-small
tokens.description: Icons inside badges, tags and checkbox.

tokens.name: size.icon.small
tokens.description: Icons inside fields and small buttons.

tokens.name: size.icon.medium
tokens.description: Icons in buttons and section headers.

tokens.name: typography.display
tokens.description: Main greeting of the view ('Welcome, Alejandro').

tokens.name: elevation.accent
tokens.description: Subtle glow of avatars and highlighted badges.

tokens.name: elevation.halo-brand
tokens.description: Soft glow behind success icons and large avatars.

tokens.name: motion.reduced-duration
tokens.description: Duration when the user asks for reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion).

tokens.name: motion.loop-duration
tokens.description: One full cycle of looping animations (Spinner).

tokens.name: layer.raised
tokens.description: Elements above the content (cards on hover).

tokens.name: opacity.disabled
tokens.description: Opacity of a disabled primary action, which keeps its brand color.
